purpose: Test context-derived corner proposals before deciding whether any may become training targets.

selection.method: Assistant original-image review followed by mapping existing reference row IDs. No geometry errors or PR35 predictions used for selection.
selection.rank_origin: Manually assigned consecutive physical layers within the selected stack. Equal physical pitch and coplanarity are assumptions, not measured guarantees.
selection.independence: Development images previously used for model selection; nearby frame IDs may show the same physical rack and objects. This is not an independent test set.

protocol.interpolation: For each listed target independently, exclude its entire annotation from donor inputs; use nearest fully labelled member above and below by rank.
protocol.extrapolation: Hold out both listed final fully labelled members together; use the two nearest remaining fully labelled members above the first target. One- and two-rank extensions are kept in a separate lane.
protocol.predictor_inputs: Only donor endpoint coordinates and rank ratio. No target bbox, target endpoint, PR35 prediction, or image-derived target extent.
protocol.uncertainty: No calibrated confidence or interval. Method disagreement is only a diagnostic and does not bound error.
protocol.promotion: No inferred proposal is accepted as observed reference or training label in this pilot.

hidden_cases.reason: Same visually identifiable stack; left lower corner is hidden by the gripper. Right endpoint is withheld from fitting and used only as a visible-side check. No donor below.
